div.p: This page lists the released versions of the Bangladesh Core FHIR Implementation Guide with the description recorded for each release. The version history page links to every published version.

ul.li: DGDA drug registry: the code system and value set canonicals moved to the DGHS namespace (https://fhir.dghs.gov.bd/core/CodeSystem/dgda-drug-registry and https://fhir.dghs.gov.bd/core/ValueSet/dgda-registered-drugs). The former dgda.gov.bd identifiers are kept as legacy aliases in a NamingSystem; data coded with them must be updated.
EDQM dose forms: the code system URI is http://standardterms.edqm.eu; the value set id is now edqm-dose-forms (canonical unchanged).

LOINC laboratory bindings: Observation.code of the laboratory panel and result profiles is bound at extensible strength to IG value sets defined with LOINC filters, and must carry a LOINC coding (invariant bd-loinc-code). Coded results are bound at extensible strength to the LOINC answer-list value set. Membership in the curated national lists is enforced by the national terminology server.
Immunization: reaction.detail and reasonReference target the BD Observation profile.
DGDA Drug and LOINC Integration with minor bug fixes
ICD-11 MMS integration and minor bug fixes
Second draft release of the Bangladesh Core FHIR IG

div.p: 2025-10-02 v0.2.0 - first official draft release, based on FHIR R4

ul.li: BD Patient profile with Bangladesh-specific identifier and address extensions
Identifier CodeSystem and ValueSet: National ID (NID), Birth Registration Number (BRN) and Unique Health ID (UHID)
Bangladesh Address profile with division, district, upazila and union levels
Initial examples for Patient and Practitioner
